rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to Vikunja self-hosted task management through 42 tools spanning tasks, comments, labels, projects, teams, users, views, and filters. Uses streamable HTTP transport with OAuth 2.0 authentication compatible with Claude.ai. Designed as a single-user server deployed via Docker or standalone Node.js behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.
